# opalstack_mailuser (Data Source)

Looks up a mailbox by `id` or by `name`. Its password is never read.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opalstack_mailuser" "info" {
  name = "info"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) UUID of the mailbox.
- `name` (String) Login name of the mailbox.

### Read-Only

- `imap_server_id` (String) UUID of the IMAP server that holds the mailbox.
